editor_note: Monthly license list; chains and short-term rentals are a brief, not a call-today item.
headline: August SLC licenses: dozens of short-term rentals, Dollar Loan Center, Sweetgreen, Boeing
title: August 2026 New Business Licenses
why_it_matters: The list includes large blocks of short-term rental units: The Ritchie Group (20 units at 111 S 300 W), The Whitney (16 at 1481 S 400 W) and Journeyman Apartments (10 at 646 S 400 W). Chains include Dollar Loan Center (1768 S Redwood Rd), Sweetgreen (2188 S Highland Dr), Swig (451 S 1400 E), Cafe Rio and Apollo Burger (301 W South Temple St), 7-Eleven (1609 S 1100 E) and Maverik (414 W 500 S). Large employers include Amazon (620 S 5700 W), Boeing (1760 N 2200 W) and SkyWest Airlines (1220 N and 1440 N 2200 W).
